title: He has seen your position before (Magnus Carlsen's memory, Hans Tikkanen and the Woodpecker Method) x Chessigma Supercoach
post:
You can surprise a human. But not a library. ♟️
Magnus Carlsen names famous games from a single position. One man built that kind of memory by copying a woodpecker 🐦
Test yours: Chessigma's game reviews are free and unlimited, on the App Store and Google Play. Link in bio.
How many puzzles did you solve today? 👇
#ad #chessigma #chess #magnuscarlsen #woodpeckermethod #chesstok #chesspuzzles

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: Magnus Carlsen can name a famous chess game from a single position.
phrases.say: [impressed] Magnus Carlsen can name a famous chess game... from a single position.

phrases.text: In one test, only one position stumped him. It was from Harry Potter.
phrases.say: In one test, only one position stumped him. [amused] It was from Harry Potter.

phrases.text: You can surprise a human. But not a library. He has seen your position before.
phrases.say: [dramatic] You can surprise a human. But not a library. He has seen your position... before.

phrases.text: And one man built that kind of memory by copying a woodpecker.
phrases.say: And one man built that kind of memory... [amused] by copying a woodpecker.

phrases.text: A grandmaster remembers whole positions. How many pawns can you? Test it on Chessigma, today's sponsor: pawns flash, then vanish, and you put them back. And its game reviews are free: more on that at the end.
phrases.say: A grandmaster remembers whole positions. [curious] How many pawns can you? Test it on Chess-Sigma, today's sponsor: pawns flash... then vanish, and you put them back. And its game reviews are free. More on that at the end.

phrases.text: His plan sounds too simple. Over a thousand puzzles. Solve them all. Then solve the same ones again, in half the time.
phrases.say: His plan sounds... too simple. Over a thousand puzzles. Solve them all. [dramatic] Then solve the same ones again... in half the time.

phrases.text: Four weeks. Then two. Then one. Then days, until the whole set takes one single day.
phrases.say: Four weeks. Then two. Then one. Then days... until the whole set takes... one single day.

phrases.text: By then, he isn't calculating anymore. He just sees it.
phrases.say: [impressed] By then, he isn't calculating anymore. He just... sees it.

phrases.text: Chessigma's Supercoach runs this method for you. It times every cycle, and only lets you move on when you're faster and cleaner.
phrases.say: Chess-Sigma's Supercoach runs this method for you. It times every cycle... and only lets you move on when you're faster... and cleaner.

phrases.text: As for the man in the red hat: three grandmaster norms in seven weeks. And his name? Hans Tikkanen. In Finnish, it means little woodpecker.
phrases.say: As for the man in the red hat... three grandmaster norms, in seven weeks. [mischievously] And his name? Hans Tikkanen. In Finnish, it means... little woodpecker.

phrases.text: That's why it's called the Woodpecker Method.
phrases.say: That's why it's called... the Woodpecker Method.

phrases.text: Today, you don't need a thousand printed puzzles. The sets are in Chessigma.
phrases.say: Today, you don't need a thousand printed puzzles. The sets are in Chess-Sigma.

phrases.text: Its coach reads your own games and builds your training plan every morning.
phrases.say: Its coach reads your own games... and builds your training plan, every morning.

phrases.text: And the best part is free: unlimited game reviews. Every move graded, your accuracy, the best move. It's on the App Store and Google Play. Link in bio.
phrases.say: [excited] And the best part is free: unlimited game reviews. Every move graded, your accuracy, the best move. It's on the App Store, and Google Play. Link in bio.

phrases.text: So, how many puzzles did you solve today?
phrases.say: [curious] So... how many puzzles did you solve today?
